blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY, Philippines — Anti-narcotics operatives seized P3.4 million worth of suspected shabu and arrested a high-value drug suspect in a buy-bust operation in Barangay Bayabas here on Thursday, Nov. 19. In a press advisory on Saturday, the Northern Mindanao Police Regional Office (PRO 10) reported that the Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit (RPDEU) Team 2 led the operation in coordination with other police units in the city that arrested the suspect, only known as alias “Tax,” 38, single, unemployed, and a resident of Barangay Bayabas.
